uiAtlas:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production pixel-art game UI atlas, 1536 x 1024, genuinely transparent background.
Primary request: a warm handcrafted countryside life-sim interface for THE HIVE, inspired by the cozy readability of Stardew Valley. Original artwork, not a copy of any game's assets.
Style: exceptionally clean 16-bit pixel art, chunky deliberate pixels, compact warm palette, chocolate-brown outlines, honey oak, warm cream parchment, small sage-green leaf accents. Flat game sprites, no photographic grain, no metallic filigree, no glow, no isometric perspective.
Composition: EXACTLY SIX independent assets in a perfectly regular 3-column by 2-row grid, each cell 512 x 512. All centered inside their cell with generous transparent padding, no overlap, no labels.
Top-left cell: a wide rustic wooden sign about 440 x 170 px with the exact legible carved cream text "THE HIVE", tiny leaf and bee accent, simple wooden bracket ends. 
Top-middle cell: a square 360 x 360 px nine-slice panel: light cream empty parchment center, simple 3-step dark brown and honey oak border, small square reinforced corners. The central 70% is quiet plain parchment, no writing or pictures.
Top-right cell: a square 300 x 300 px empty wooden inventory-slot button: warm tan recessed center, thick simple dark oak pixel border. No icon or text, symmetrical and usable for nine-slicing.
Bottom-left cell: a closed cream field journal with a sage fabric bookmark, three-quarter top-down RPG inventory icon, 220 x 220 px.
Bottom-middle cell: a cream envelope with a small amber wax seal, three-quarter top-down RPG inventory icon, 220 x 220 px.
Bottom-right cell: a folded parchment map with a little green meadow and blue stream drawing, three-quarter top-down RPG inventory icon, 220 x 220 px.
Constraints: keep every sprite wholly within its grid cell; real transparent alpha outside the sprites; no checkerboard drawn into the image; no shadows extending far from sprites; no additional text beyond THE HIVE; crisp pixel edges, no antialiasing. This is a real sprite atlas to crop into the game, not a mockup or screenshot.
homesteadMap:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: a finished playable overhead countryside game map, landscape 1536 x 1024 pixels.
Primary request: THE HIVE as a beautiful small homestead of SIX cozy working cottages, inspired by the warm charm, clarity and handcrafted pixel art of Stardew Valley. Original setting and original buildings. This is the actual background for an interactive game, not a mockup.
Camera: consistent 3/4 top-down orthographic RPG view, north at the top, no horizon, no perspective convergence. Crisp deliberate pixel clusters at roughly a 768 x 512 logical resolution, restrained texture detail, no blur or photographic grain.
Layout matters: exactly three separate cottages in the upper row and three in the lower row. A wide quiet ochre dirt lane runs horizontally across the ENTIRE map at y=500 to 570, with open space for walking. Short narrow paths connect the houses to that central lane, including paths around the sides of the lower houses to their front doors.
Upper-left building centered around (300,300), within x=165..460,y=140..440: a cream-plaster library cottage, deep moss-green roof, blue shutters, a small hanging book symbol.
Upper-center building centered around (770,280), within x=620..920,y=120..430: a warm timber meeting hall, terracotta roof, small bell cupola, blank outdoor noticeboard by its door.
Upper-right building centered around (1230,310), within x=1080..1390,y=150..445: a stone tool shed, weathered slate-blue roof, tiny crossed-tools sign, stacked firewood.
Lower-left building centered around (300,770), within x=165..470,y=650..950: a quiet little study cottage with a plum roof, cream walls, ivy and a reading bench in its garden.
Lower-center building centered around (770,770), within x=610..930,y=640..955: a welcoming commons house with a honey-orange roof, wide porch, sage shutters and an obvious red wooden mailbox near its front door.
Lower-right building centered around (1240,780), within x=1080..1400,y=670..955: a compact red timber maker's barn with a warm dark brown roof, a small workbench and timber stack outside.
Surroundings: sunny late-spring grass in soft fresh greens, clusters of leafy oak trees around the outer edges, low wooden fences and gates, restrained white and yellow wildflowers, neat small vegetable beds, a little blue pond in the far left margin near the lane. A few beehives in an orchard corner. Keep the central lane clear. Each cottage has its own little garden, with generous breathing room between buildings.
Lighting: gentle golden late-afternoon sunlight from upper left, natural warm highlights and compact cool green shadows. Cozy, welcoming and cared for. Quiet readable ground; do not cover every tile with busy dots.
Constraints: exactly six buildings, all roofs and doors fully visible, no people, no animals, no characters, no UI, no text or letters, no labels, no logo, no border. No extra buildings outside the six. Clear silhouettes and crop-safe outer margins. Finish the complete map edge to edge.
